questions.question: What did the remnant ask Jeremiah to do in chapter 42?
options: Pray and seek God's guidance on whether to stay or flee
Crown for them a brand new king over the whole remnant
Lead them out to battle against the great Babylonian army
Carry their bitter complaint before the king of Egypt
questions.answer: Pray and seek God's guidance on whether to stay or flee

questions.question: What did God tell them through Jeremiah?
options: Take up their arms and rise in open revolt against all the Babylonians
Flee away at once to Egypt, where they would surely find safety
Stay in the land and do not go to Egypt; if they did, they would die
Scatter abroad and seek what refuge they could among the nations
questions.answer: Stay in the land and do not go to Egypt; if they did, they would die

questions.question: The people promised to obey whatever the LORD said, whether good or bad, before they heard the answer.
If you remain in this land, I will build you up and not pull you down, for I _____ over the disaster.
Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, for I am with you to save you and _____ you.
